name: Thermal pad
definition: solid sheet of thermal interface material cut to sit between a chip or drive and its cooler.
reason: Solid pad differs in form and use from paste (C10(b)); harvester saw ARCTIC TP-3 and TP-4 pads sold on the fetched page.

name: TV tuner card
definition: card fitted inside the computer that receives broadcast television.
reason: Memo section 9 makes it D1 (S3); no expansion-card kind receives TV. Wikipedia list page is not a seller page: attest before entry.

name: Macro pad
definition: separate input device of a few programmable keys, dials or sliders used for shortcuts, not for typing.
reason: Neither keyboard (typing) nor numeric keypad (number keys); sold and compared apart (MX Creative Console).

name: Wide-format printer
definition: printer that prints on roll or sheet media wider than A3, for drawings and posters.
reason: Size-against-format test (C6): needs roll media and is sold apart. Harvester URL is a multifunction page: confirm it shows the type.

name: Range extender
definition: network device that receives a wireless signal and rebroadcasts it to widen coverage.
reason: Repeats wireless to wireless; an access point needs a wired uplink. Navigation page: confirm the extender listing on fetch.

name: Powerline adapter
definition: adapter that carries a network connection over a building's mains wiring, sold in pairs or kits.
reason: Different medium and installation (C10(b)); no D1.5 kind covers it. Navigation page: confirm on fetch.

name: Modem
definition: device that connects a home network to a provider's cable, DSL, fibre or cellular line; one with a built-in router is this kind.
reason: No D1.5 kind connects to the provider line. Navigation page: confirm a modem listing on fetch.

name: PoE injector
definition: device that adds power to an Ethernet cable to feed a powered network device.
reason: Neither switch nor adapter; harvester saw it sold on the Raspberry Pi products page.

name: DisplayPort cable
definition: cable with DisplayPort or Mini DisplayPort connectors.
reason: Cable kinds grow by connector family (memo D1.6). URL is a charger page: a fetched DisplayPort cable page is needed.

name: Potentiometer
definition: loose variable resistor set by a shaft, slider or trimmer screw.
reason: Mouser class (D-9 carries loose parts to the class level); leaf names provisional.

name: Thermistor
definition: loose resistor whose resistance changes with temperature (NTC or PTC).
reason: Mouser class (D-9); not the sensor kind, which is a packaged sensing component.

name: Varistor
definition: loose voltage-dependent resistor used to absorb surges.
reason: Mouser class (D-9); circuit-protection grouping may become a leaf at the Mouser harvest.

name: Transformer
definition: loose component that transfers power or signal between coils.
reason: Mouser passive class (D-9); not an inductor (one coil).

name: Crystal or oscillator
definition: loose frequency-control component (quartz crystal, resonator or oscillator).
reason: Mouser frequency-control class (D-9); leaf provisional.

name: Diode
definition: loose semiconductor that lets current pass one way (rectifier, Zener, Schottky).
reason: Mouser discrete semiconductor class (D-9).

name: LED
definition: loose light-emitting diode component for circuits (a lamp or bulb is B-lighting).
reason: Mouser optoelectronics class (D-9); placed in Semiconductors until the harvest sets leaves.

name: Add-on board for a maker board
definition: board made to plug onto one maker-board family's header (HAT, shield, FeatherWing).
reason: Made to be fitted to one kind of object, so it follows the board into the parts sub-family (S3, C5(d)).

name: Laptop stand
definition: stand or riser without fans made to hold one laptop at a height or angle.
reason: Holder made for one object follows it (S3, K-8 analogue); laptop cooler needs fans.

name: Overcoat
definition: tailored wool or wool-blend coat ending below the hip, worn over a suit or jacket.
reason: Coats leaf has no tailored overcoat; memo 4b names coats by cut. Confirm Gloverall page shows overcoats.

name: Work jacket
definition: short hard-wearing jacket of duck canvas or similar, zip or button front, made for work; chore coat and trucker patterns keep their kinds.
reason: Detroit and Active fit neither chore coat nor trucker; work pants is the trouser parallel. Models become named forms.

candidate: Other military flight jackets (CWU-45/P, B-15, A-2)
name: Flight jacket (bomber)

reason: MA-1 stays its own kind (4b); other bomber patterns and generic bombers had no home. Patterns become non-maker named forms.

name: Anorak
definition: hooded pullover jacket of windproof or waterproof fabric with a part-length front opening.
reason: Memo 4b names anorak as a buyer cut; pullover form differs from shell jacket. URL is a fleece page: confirm on fetch.

name: Parka
definition: hooded insulated coat with a smooth outer shell, ending below the hip, cut for cold weather; a quilted face is the puffer coat.
reason: Memo 4b names parka as a buyer cut; TNF files parkas apart. TNF Arctic and McMurdo move here.

name: Field jacket
definition: hip-length military-style cotton jacket with four front pockets in a pattern other than the M-65 (M-43, M-51, safari-style).
reason: M-65 stays its own kind (4b); other field patterns had no home. Confirm the Gloverall page shows one.

name: Pocket square
definition: square of cloth folded and worn in the breast pocket of a jacket.
reason: A worn cloth accessory with no A1.7 home; not an ornament (A3). Confirm the page shows pocket squares.

name: Face shield
definition: clear visor on a headband or hard-hat mount that protects the whole face from impact or splash.
reason: Not eyewear and not a welding helmet; P14 files protective gear by form. Confirm the page lists face shields.

name: Earplugs
definition: plugs worn in the ear canal to reduce noise reaching the ears.
reason: Form differs from ear defenders (muffs); hearing PPE is A1 by step 17.

name: Balaclava
definition: close-fitting head covering that also covers the neck and part or all of the face.
reason: No headwear kind covers face and neck; seller lists it with caps and beanies.

name: Headband
definition: band of fabric or knit worn round the head or ears, held by its own elastic or ties.
reason: P16 makes a headband A1 headwear but A1.6 has no kind; a hair band of plain elastic is H1.

name: Shapewear
definition: elastic garment without boning worn under clothing to smooth or shape the figure; a boned shaping garment is the corset.
reason: P8 keeps it in A1; buyers compare it apart from boned corsets. A Wikipedia category is not a seller page: attest first.

name: Tank top (camisole)
definition: sleeveless top held by shoulder straps or narrow shoulders, of jersey or light fabric.
reason: T-shirt has sleeves by definition; sold as its own category. Camisole is a named form or alias.

name: Blouse
definition: woven top cut for women, with a placket, tie, yoke or collar detail but not a full collared button front; that is the button-up shirt.
reason: Leaf is named Shirts and blouses but has no blouse kind. Partial fetch: confirm the page shows blouses.

name: Tailored trousers
definition: trousers with a fly, waistband and pressed or flat front made for smart or formal wear, sold apart from a suit.
reason: Trousers leaf has no generic smart trouser; suit trousers stay with the suit set.

name: Leggings
definition: close-fitting stretch trousers without feet; footed versions are tights.
reason: Step 17 keeps everyday leggings in A1; no trouser or hosiery kind fits.

name: Culottes
definition: wide-legged trousers cut to hang like a skirt, ending between knee and ankle.
reason: Leg divisions exclude skirt; length past the knee excludes shorts; sold as its own category.

name: Sweater vest
definition: sleeveless knitted top, pullover or buttoned.
reason: Knitwear precedence already names knitted vests but no kind holds them.

name: Chainsaw chaps
definition: cut-resistant leg aprons strapped over ordinary trousers for chainsaw work; hazard rating is an attribute.
reason: Worn over trousers, not a trouser; P14 files PPE by body zone and form.
